title.en: First Thing: US continues attacks on Iran ‘in honor’ of dead service members | Martin Belam
title.zh: 美国为“纪念”阵亡军人继续袭击伊朗

summary.en: The United States has carried out a ninth consecutive night of strikes targeting Iran, following the announcement of another American service member's death.
summary.zh: 在又一名美国军人死亡的消息公布后，美国对伊朗发动了连续第九晚的袭击。

body.en: The US has launched a ninth night of strikes targeting Iran. Plus, the glorious art deco LA library celebrates 100 years Good morning. The US launched a ninth night of strikes targeting Iran early Monday, after announcing the death of another American service member – the third in recent days. Donald Trump said the new attacks were “in honor” of the dead. Iranian supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei warned in a statement of “unforgettable lessons” if the US kept attacking. Trump has threatened to target Iran’s power stations and bridges to try to compel Tehran to loosen its hold on the strait of Hormuz. Last week the US reimposed a naval blockade on Iranian ports. The military on Saturday said it had redirected six ships and disabled one since then. Oil prices rose at the opening of trading in Asia on Monday, with the price of Brent crude climbing 2.72% to $90.50 a barrel. Where have US service personnel been killed? The service member was killed on Saturday in northern Iraq during a controlled detonation of what was called unexploded ordnance on a downed Iranian attack drone. It was the third US death in recent days, after two military service personnel were killed in an Iranian attack on a Jordanian airbase on Friday, with a third missing in action. Since the war began, 17 US service members have been killed. What is the US mission against Iran? The war was started in February when the former Iranian supreme leader was killed in joint US-Israeli strikes. Trump has indicated several motives for the war, including preventing Tehran from gaining nuclear weapons and trying to force regime change. On Sunday, the US energy secretary, Chris Wright, argued the mission has shifted toward ensuring oil shipments can move through Hormuz, after the US-Iran ceasefire has faltered. What did Mamdani say? “I believe that Netanyahu belongs in The Hague. He’s a war criminal who has been charged by the ICC, and what you will find is that is an opinion that is held by many, purely because of what his actions have wrought over these past many years. Whatever the law allows me to do in New York City, that’s what we will do.” What is Netanyahu accused of by the ICC? The warrant which the ICC issued for the arrest of Netanyahu and other Israeli leaders accused them of war crimes and crimes against humanity in Gaza, including “starvation as a method of warfare, and … murder, persecution, and other inhumane acts”. body.zh: 美国已连续第九晚对伊朗发动空袭。此外，辉煌的装饰艺术风格洛杉矶图书馆庆祝 100 周年早安。在宣布另一名美国军人死亡后，美国周一凌晨对伊朗发动了第九次袭击，这是最近几天的第三次袭击。唐纳德·特朗普表示，新的袭击是为了“纪念”死者。伊朗最高领袖哈梅内伊在一份声明中警告称，如果美国继续发动袭击，伊朗将获得“难忘的教训”。特朗普威胁要瞄准伊朗的发电站和桥梁，试图迫使德黑兰放松对霍尔木兹海峡的控制。上周，美国重新对伊朗港口实施海上封锁。军方周六表示，此后已调整了六艘船只的方向，并使其中一艘瘫痪。周一亚洲开盘，油价上涨，布伦特原油价格上涨 2.72%，至每桶 90.50 美元。美军人员在哪里被杀？周六，这名军人在伊拉克北部被击落的伊朗攻击无人机上的未爆炸弹药受控引爆身亡。这是最近几天美国发生的第三起死亡事件，此前两名军人在周五伊朗对约旦空军基地的袭击中丧生，第三人在行动中失踪。自战争开始以来，已有 17 名美国军人丧生。美国针对伊朗的使命是什么？战争始于二月，当时伊朗前最高领导人在美以联合袭击中丧生。特朗普表明了发动战争的几个动机，包括阻止德黑兰获得核武器和试图迫使政权更迭。周日，美国能源部长克里斯·赖特 (Chris Wright) 表示，在美伊停火协议动摇后，任务已转向确保石油运输能够通过霍尔木兹海峡。马姆达尼说了什么？ “我相信内塔尼亚胡属于海牙。他是一名受到国际刑事法院指控的战犯，你会发现这是许多人持有的观点，纯粹是因为他在过去多年的行为所造成的影响。无论法律允许我在纽约做什么，我们都会做什么。”国际刑事法院指控内塔尼亚胡的罪名是什么？国际刑事法院对内塔尼亚胡和其他以色列领导人发出的逮捕令指控他们在加沙犯有战争罪和反人类罪，包括“以饥饿作为一种战争手段，以及……谋杀、迫害和其他不人道行为”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of ongoing conflict and retaliatory actions, it is natural to feel the pull to respond to harm with more harm. Yet, Yahweh's word calls us to a different path, urging us not to be overcome by evil, but to actively overcome evil with good. This principle challenges us to seek ways that break cycles of violence rather than perpetuating them.
reflection.zh: 面对持续的冲突和报复行动，以伤害回应伤害是人之常情。然而，雅伟的话语呼召我们走一条不同的道路，敦促我们不要被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。这一原则挑战我们寻求打破暴力循环而非延续它的方法。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Andy Burnham pledges to end rough sleeping in first speech as prime minister – UK politics live
title.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆将成为新首相，并在唐宁街10号发表演讲，阐述英国“十年计划”——英国政治直播

summary.en: Andy Burnham is set to become the new Prime Minister of the UK and will deliver a speech from No 10 Downing Street, outlining a 10-year plan for the country. This follows Keir Starmer's final speech from the same location.
summary.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆将成为英国新首相，并将在唐宁街10号发表讲话，阐述英国的十年计划。此前，基尔·斯塔默已在同一地点发表了告别演说。

body.en:
We will help more young people into work by changing the education system and giving them more support, more mental health support, and we will build more council homes.

That is the fair and sustainable way to bring the welfare bill down to meet our fiscal rules and to honour our commitments on defence to our international partners.

We will help people to live well, building a more preventative state, investing in people’s success rather than paying for failure.

I will soon go through that door behind me and issue my first instruction – to end rough sleeping in our country.

It’s about putting the right values and the right standards at the heart of government.
body.zh: 早上好。今天我们迎来了一位新总理。这是十多年来第六次发生这种情况（特蕾莎·梅于 2016 年 7 月 13 日接替大卫·卡梅伦），因此从某些方面来看，这并没有什么新奇或令人惊讶的地方。然而这个过程却很不寻常。过去，当执政党更换首相时，通常会选择受本党议员欢迎但在广大公众中不如其前任受欢迎的人（利兹·特拉斯、特蕾莎·梅、戈登·布朗），或者更受公众欢迎但不太受本党活动人士喜欢的人（约翰·梅杰、里希·苏纳克）。今年年初，任何关注民意调查的人都会得出结论，工党的合理选择是用安迪·伯纳姆取代凯尔·斯塔默。工党并不总是因做出有利于选举的决定而闻名，但在这种情况下，这就是它所取得的成就。它取代了一位成为选举重担的总理，取而代之的是该国最受尊敬的政治家之一——至少目前如此——整个政党都支持他。 在伯纳姆任命内阁后，情况可能最终不会发生。我们得看看。以下是罗威娜·梅森 (Rowena Mason) 昨晚讲述的关于今天会发生什么的故事。 伯纳姆接受了《泰晤士报》的采访，虽然其中没有任何重大的新公告，但其中充满了关于他将如何执政的有趣线索。有两个特别突出。 首先，伯纳姆表示他将为该国制定一个“十年计划”。他还告诉《泰晤士报》，这是关于他的野心规模的声明，而不是关于他计划担任总理多久。采访伯纳姆的帕特里克·马奎尔说道： 本周[伯纳姆]将告诉我们他的“国家十年计划”。他承认，也许他的首相任期不会持续那么久。 “我并不是说这意味着我要在这里待十年……更多的是我们在结构上没有处于正确的位置，我们作为一个国家没有处于正确的位置。我认为人们可以感觉到这一点。” 其次，伯纳姆驳斥了有关他本质上是税收筹集者的说法。他甚至建议，他想扭转个人免税额的冻结，这种冻结起到了隐形税的作用，导致人们每年随着工资上涨而缴纳的税款成比例增加，但免税额却没有增加。伯纳姆告诉马奎尔： 我在梅克菲尔德家门口听到最多的一件事是对冻结在 12,570 英镑的个人津贴感到沮丧……[那个抱怨]留在了我的脑海里。 伯纳姆没有承诺结束冻结，这将花费数十亿美元。但他表示自己并不是下意识的增税者。他告诉马奎尔： 他们只是把我描述为一个征税者。好吧，再说一遍，事情从来没有那么简单，不是吗？ 最后的...

reflection.en: As a new Prime Minister steps into office with a long-term plan, the wisdom of Proverbs reminds us that a clear vision is essential for a nation's flourishing. Without purposeful guidance, societies can drift; with it, there is hope for stability and progress. May Yahweh grant leaders insight to chart a course that serves the common good.
reflection.zh: 随着新首相上任并提出十年计划，箴言的智慧提醒我们，清晰的愿景对国家的繁荣至关重要。没有有目的的指引，社会可能迷失方向；有了它，就有稳定和进步的希望。愿雅伟赐予领导者洞察力，为共同利益规划路线。

verse.textEn: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom's instruction.
verse.textZh: 没有异象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。

title.en: ‘All I think about is her’: Families demand answers as Nigeria's boat disasters keep happening
title.zh: “我只想着她”：尼日利亚船只灾难频发，家属要求给出解释

summary.en: Hundreds of lives are lost annually in Nigeria due to recurring boat accidents, yet the situation remains unchanged. Grieving families are now demanding accountability and action from authorities.
summary.zh: 尼日利亚每年有数百人死于船只事故，但情况似乎没有改变。悲痛的家庭正在要求当局给出解释并采取行动。

body.en:
Many die in a boat accident; officials say the regulations should be followed; their calls are ignored; campaigners say the resources are not available; another tragedy happens.

This time, a search-and-rescue team is looking for survivors of a capsized wooden canoe in Jigawa state.

Forty were thought to be on board, mostly female farmers and labourers, when it sank on Sunday. Twenty-three people have been rescued alive but seven bodies have been recovered from the river so far.

Last month, a boat accident on the River Benue in central Nigeria claimed the lives of 12 people, including a pregnant woman and six children.

Earlier this year , 14 people lost their lives when their boat capsized in Gumbi, Kebbi state. They had been returning from a wedding ceremony, accompanying the bride to her new husband's home.

So far this year, more than 55 people have already lost their lives in boat accidents, with dozens of bodies yet to be recovered.

For millions of Nigerians, particularly in rural areas, rivers are the most practical means of transport. With many villages on or close to waterways and few bridges and poor roads to aid travel, rickety wooden boats are often the only way for people to reach family members elsewhere, to take goods to market, or to see the outside world.

For people like Isiyaka Bello, the painful memory of losing someone to water is still fresh. Last year, his wife was returning from a village market in Kebbi state when she and eight others lost their lives.

"It seems like just yesterday. She left behind four children, and I am still struggling to adjust to raising them on my own.

After every disaster, authorities promise to do better. But on the water there is little, if any, change.

Mallam Sala Altine holds a traditional title that carries the weight of life and death on the river. He is the Sarkin Ruwan Shiroro - the man entrusted with keeping people safe on the Shiroro Lake in Niger state, where some of Nigeria's deadliest boat tragedies have occurred.

The River Niger, the third-longest in Africa, passes through the state with which it shares a name, where it is fed by numerous smaller rivers and connected waterways, creating an environment where fatal accidents are both frequent and severe.

Between January 2023 and October 2025, Niger state accounted for a significant share of the nearly 860 deaths recorded across Nigeria. One report noted 253 deaths in the state between June 2023 and August 2025.

Altine says there is a critical shortage of life jackets despite repeated government promises to supply them.

"Our boats usually carry well over 100 passengers. But most of the time, we can only provide life jackets for 10 people, or even fewer, because we simply don't have enough," he explains.

body.zh: 许多人死于船难；官员表示应遵守规定；他们的呼唤被忽略；活动人士称资源不可用；另一场悲剧发生了。 这次，搜救队正在吉加瓦州寻找一艘翻船木船的幸存者。 周日沉没时，据信船上有四十人，其中大部分是女性农民和劳工。截至目前，已有 23 人获救，但已从河中打捞出 7 具尸体。 上个月，尼日利亚中部贝努埃河发生的一起船只事故夺去了12人的生命，其中包括一名孕妇和六名儿童。 今年早些时候，凯比州贡比发生翻船事故，造成 14 人丧生。他们刚刚结束一场婚礼，陪同新娘前往她新婚丈夫的家。 今年迄今为止，已有超过55人在船只事故中丧生，还有数十具尸体尚未打捞。 对于数百万尼日利亚人来说，特别是在农村地区，河流是最实用的交通方式。由于许多村庄位于或靠近水道，桥梁很少，交通道路也很差，摇摇晃晃的木船往往是人们与其他地方的家人联系、将货物运往市场或看看外面的世界的唯一方式。 对于像伊西亚卡·贝洛这样的人来说，在水中失去亲人的痛苦记忆仍然历历在目。去年，他的妻子和其他八人在从凯比州的一个乡村市场回来时丧生。 “这一切仿佛就发生在昨天。她留下了四个孩子，而我仍在努力适应独自抚养他们。 每次灾难发生后，当局都承诺会做得更好。但在水面上，即使有变化，也几乎没有变化。 马拉姆·萨拉·阿尔丁 (Mallam Sala Altine) 拥有一个传统头衔，承载着这条河上的生与死的重担。他就是萨金·鲁万·希罗罗 (Sarkin Ruwan Shiroro)，负责保护尼日尔州希罗罗湖上人们的安全，尼日利亚一些最致命的船难就发生在该湖上。 尼日尔河是非洲第三长河，流经与其同名的国家，该州由众多较小的河流和相连的水道注入，造成了致命事故频繁且严重的环境。 2023 年 1 月至 2025 年 10 月期间，尼日利亚全国记录的近 860 例死亡病例中，尼日尔州占了很大一部分。一份报告指出，2023 年 6 月至 2025 年 8 月期间，该州有 253 人死亡。 阿尔廷表示，尽管政府一再承诺提供救生衣，但救生衣严重短缺。 “我们的船通常载有超过 100 名乘客。但大多数时候，我们只能为 10 人甚至更少的人提供救生衣，因为我们根本没有足够的救生衣，”他解释道。 “我们希望将其定为规则......

title.en: Lamine Yamal celebrates World Cup win with little brother who charmed fans
title.zh: 拉明·亚马尔与迷倒球迷的弟弟一起庆祝世界杯胜利

summary.en: The three-year-old brother of Yamal has been hailed one of Spain's World Cup breakout stars by fans
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Spanish footballer Lamine Yamal may have lifted the World Cup but it is his little brother Kenye who appears to have stolen the spotlight.

The three-year-old quickly become an internet sensation after footage of his exuberant celebrations following Spain's 1-0 victory over Argentina spread across social media on Sunday.

While the footballer, just 19 himself, continued his rise by helping Spain achieve football's biggest prize, attention swiftly turned to his younger brother's joyful reactions from the sidelines.

From sticking out his tongue on the big screen to wildly cheering on his older brother, Kenye has been hailed by fans as one of the unexpected breakout stars of the 2026 tournament.

Spain triumphed in a battle of endurance, beating Argentina with a goal in the 106th minute at the New York New Jersey Stadium.

The team's second World Cup win has led to Lamine Yamal becoming the youngest player ever to win both the European Championship and the World Cup.

His younger brother Kenye has become a regular fixture both on and off the pitch - often featuring in Lamine Yamal's TikToks and charming fans from around the world.

The three-year-old, who appears keen to follow in his big brother's footsteps, is the son of Lamine Yamal's mother Sheila Ebana.

Speaking about Kenye, Lamine Yamal previously told outlets: "I'm moved when I see my little brother this happy, as well as seeing my mum and friends living the life they always dreamed of.

"My little brother means everything to me. I am in love with him; it feels like he is my son."

In what could be seen as a symbolic passing of the torch, Lamine Yamal went head to head with Argentinan football legend Lionel Messi for the first time during the World Cup final.

The two had crossed paths years earlier in 2007 when Messi, then 20, was seen cradling and bathing a tiny baby boy - Lamine Yamal - after his mother won a competition to meet a Barcelona first-team player.

Days ahead of Sunday's final, Messi, now 39, described Lamine Yamal as "one of the best" footballers right now.

"He's a tremendous player - a global star. He's 19 years old and has his whole career ahead of him. I wish him the best, but we'll give it our all to ensure he doesn't become champion this time," he added.

As the full-time whistle blew, cementing Spain's victory, the pair could be seen embracing on the pitch.
body.zh: 西班牙足球运动员拉明·亚马尔可能举起了世界杯冠军，但抢尽风头的却是他的弟弟肯耶。 周日，西班牙1-0战胜阿根廷后，这位三岁小伙子的精彩庆祝视频在社交媒体上传播开来，迅速成为网络红人。 当这位年仅 19 岁的足球运动员通过帮助西班牙获得足球界最高奖项而继续崛起时，人们的注意力很快转向了他弟弟在场边的快乐反应。 从在大屏幕上吐舌头到为哥哥疯狂欢呼，肯耶被球迷誉为 2026 年锦标赛中意想不到的突破明星之一。 西班牙在一场耐力战中取得胜利，在纽约新泽西体育场第106分钟进球击败阿根廷。 球队第二次夺得世界杯冠军，拉明·亚马尔成为有史以来同时赢得欧洲杯和世界杯的最年轻球员。 他的弟弟肯耶 (Kenye) 已成为球场内外的常客，经常出现在拉明·亚马尔 (Lamine Yamal) 的 TikTok 视频中，吸引了来自世界各地的球迷。 这个三岁的孩子似乎热衷于追随哥哥的脚步，他是拉明·亚马尔 (Lamine Yamal) 母亲希拉·埃巴纳 (Sheila Ebana) 的儿子。 谈到肯耶，拉明·亚马尔此前告诉媒体：“当我看到我的弟弟如此快乐，以及看到我的妈妈和朋友过着他们一直梦想的生活时，我很感动。 “我的弟弟对我来说意味着一切。我爱上了他；感觉就像他是我的儿子。” 拉明·亚马尔在世界杯决赛中首次与阿根廷足球传奇人物莱昂内尔·梅西正面交锋，这可以被视为象征性的火炬传递。 两人早在2007年就曾有过交集，当时20岁的梅西的母亲赢得了一场与巴塞罗那一线队球员会面的比赛，当时20岁的梅西正抱着一个小男婴拉明·亚马尔(Lamine Yamal)洗澡。 在周日决赛前几天，现年 39 岁的梅西将拉明·亚马尔描述为目前“最好的”足球运动员之一。 “他是一位出色的球员——一位全球巨星。他今年 19 岁，他的整个职业生涯都在等着他。我祝他一切顺利，但我们会竭尽全力确保他这次不会成为冠军，”他补充道。 随着终场哨声响起，西班牙队锁定了胜利，可以看到两人在球场上拥抱。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to hope, endurance, and faithful rebuilding. Romans 12:12 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with steady hope and perseverance, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

title.en: Why Japan's new imperial law keeps women off the throne
title.zh: 日本新皇室法为何将女性排除在皇位之外

summary.en: New legislation in Japan aims to address the declining number of members in the imperial family. The law maintains the tradition of male-only succession, despite significant public support for allowing a female emperor.
summary.zh: 日本的新立法旨在解决皇室成员日益减少的问题。尽管公众普遍支持女性天皇，但该法律仍保留了男性继承皇位的传统。

body.en:
New legislation aims to address the shrinking ranks of Japan's imperial family, while preserving male-only succession despite broad support for a female emperor.

Japan's Parliament on Friday approved the first major revision of the country's imperial succession laws, to address the risk that the last young male heir may not have a son.

By law, only a paternal-lineage male can become emperor in Japan . Female royals have been required to leave the imperial family when they marry commoners.

Japanese Emperor Naruhito, who acceded to the Imperial Throne in 2019, and his wife Empress Masako have one child, 24-year-old Princess Aiko, who was born in 2021. She cannot inherit the throne under the current system.

Instead, Naruhito's younger brother Prince Akishino (also known as Fumihito) is considered the crown prince. Akishino's son, Prince Hisahito, would be second in line to the throne.

In 2005, a panel appointed by then-Prime Minister Junichiro Koizumi unanimously recommended allowing female emperors and succession through the female line. The proposal was shelved after Prince Hisahito's birth the following year eased immediate concerns.

At the moment, there are only three candidates who could theoretically succeed the 66-year-old Naruhito: his brother, Crown Prince Akishino (60), Prince Hisahito (19), and Naruhito's uncle Prince Hitachi (90).

The latest changes, however, allow male members of former collateral branches of the imperial family to be readmitted. Those branches lost their imperial status after Japan's surrender at the end of  World War II and their members have since lived as private citizens.

Under the new law, men from those branches may enter the family through adoption if they are at least 15 years old. The adoptees themselves will not receive succession rights, but their future male-line sons will be eligible for the throne. 

Opinion polls suggest that the compromise reached by parliament — while endorsed by Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi — is unpopular with much of the wider public, who would rather see Emperor Naruhito's daughter inherit the throne. 

A nationwide Mainichi Shimbun poll conducted in June found that 40% of respondents supported both a female emperor and female-line succession, while 33% supported a female emperor but opposed female-line succession. Overall, 73% supported a female emperor, compared with 6% who opposed the idea.

This is the first significant revision of the Imperial Household Law since 1947, and it shows "that gender equality is not among the priorities," Sven Saaler of Sophia University in Tokyo said. "A woman on the imperial throne has been pushed even further into the distance by the legal amendment," he told Germany's dpa news agency.

reflection.en: The debate over Japan's imperial succession highlights the tension between tradition and the equal dignity of all people. Yahweh created both male and female in His image, endowing each with inherent worth and capacity. This foundational truth encourages us to value every individual's potential, regardless of gender, in all spheres of life.
reflection.zh: 日本皇位继承的争议凸显了传统与所有人平等尊严之间的张力。雅伟照着自己的形象创造了男人和女人，赋予每个人固有的价值和能力。这一基本真理鼓励我们在生活的各个领域，不分性别，都珍视每个人的潜力。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.

title.en: Why are thousands of people protesting in Delhi?
title.zh: 为什么成千上万的人在德里抗议？

summary.en: Thousands of mostly young people have marched on India's parliament to demand changes to how the education system is run.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
In India, tens of thousands of Gen Z protesters have taken to the streets of the capital Delhi, calling for the resignation of the country's education minister.

Starting as a satirical online movement just a few months ago, the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) is now one of India's most visible youth movements.

Despite its humorous origins, the CJP group quickly became a lightning rod for India's disaffected young people.

The movement is led by Abhijeet Dipke, a 30-year-old political communications strategist and former student at Boston University.

He has said that the movement was started as a joke, but after offering the option to sign up to the movement through a Google form, he received tens of thousands of responses.

The trigger for Monday's protests came from the treatment of Sonam Wangchuk, a well-known engineer and activist, who had been on hunger strike for 20 days in support of the CJP party at Jantar Mantar, a 300-year-old observatory in Delhi, which is often the site of protests.

On Saturday, the 59-year-old was forcibly taken to hospital , prompting CJP leader Dipke to call on protesters to march on India's parliament on Monday.

The name of the Cockroach Janta Party (the Cockroach People's Party) came about in response to comments made by India's Chief Justice, Surya Kant.

During a hearing, he allegedly compared unemployed young people drifting towards journalism and activism to cockroaches and parasites.

He later clarified that he had been referring specifically to people with "fake and bogus degrees", not India's youth more broadly.

The name is a parody of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), which has been in power since 2014.

Spilling off the internet and into real life, young volunteers to the movement have turned up dressed as cockroaches at clean-up drives and protests.

The CJP is mostly protesting over issues they have with India's education system.

The National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) is India's main entrance exam for admission to medical colleges across the country.

Nearly 2.28 million candidates sat the exam on 3 May, having studied for months - in some cases years - for the notoriously difficult paper. However, days later, it was cancelled after allegations that the questions had been leaked.

It was a big blow to aspirants, who had to resit the exam under tight security weeks later. Anger over this was one of the reasons the CJP began its protest.

It and families have also alleged that some 20 students died by suicide due to distress after the exam was cancelled.

The CJP is calling for the education system to be overhauled, with greater accountability over alleged exam paper leaks and the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan.

title.en: Utah firefighter and four family members killed in flash flooding
title.zh: 犹他州消防员和四名家庭成员在山洪中丧生

summary.en: A husband, wife and their three sons died - meaning that only a daughter who did not join the outing is still alive.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Five members of a Utah family were killed in a flash flood over the weekend after going out for a day of hiking in the southern part of the US state, according to law enforcement officials.

The victims included a fire captain, Spencer Long, his wife and three sons. A daughter who did not join the outing is the only member of the family not to have died.

"It is believed the family fell victim to flooding caused by heavy rains," the Wayne County Sheriff's Office said in a statement, which did not name those who were killed.

Identification of the family instead came from Provo Fire & Rescue, which announced the death of Captain Spencer Long in a statement of its own.

"We are absolutely heartbroken by the death of Captain Spencer Long and his family," the fire department said. "Our thoughts are with his family, friends, and colleagues during this difficult time."

A GoFundMe page appears to connect the sheriff's statement with the fire department and says that Long, his wife Katrina and their three sons - Reid, Thayne and Gage - died in a flash flood incident.

The fundraising effort also says that the couple had a daughter whose "life has forever been changed in an instant".

The family arrived at a campground near Bicknell, Utah, for a day trip on Friday, the sheriff's office said in its statement.

Officials were called to that campground around 17:00 local time (23:00 GMT) on Friday, where a young male victim was found dead.

On Saturday, the search resumed for the remaining two individuals, who the sheriff's office later confirmed were found dead.

title.en: Scores feared dead after passenger ferry capsizes off Guyana
title.zh: 客轮在圭亚那倾覆后可能造成数十人死亡

summary.en: Sixty-seven people have been rescued but the ferry is thought to have had more than 130 people on board.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Scores of people are feared to have drowned after a passenger ferry capsized off the coast of Guyana on Saturday night local time.

Sixty-seven people were rescued on Sunday, officials said, but since then rescue workers have been unable to locate any more survivors.

According to the ferry's passenger list, it was carrying 116 passengers and 17 crew, but Guyana's prime minister has warned that the list is not accurate.

Divers continue to search the site where the vessel capsized and people who believe their loved ones may have been on board the stricken vessel have been asked to contact the authorities.

Prime Minister Mark Phillips said an investigation had been launched into the ferry's loss.

"Let me be absolutely clear: where negligence, misconduct or criminal wrongdoing is established, those responsible will face the full force of the law," he said.

Guyana's Public Works Minister, Juan Edghill, expressed his anger at a news conference on Sunday, accusing those who operated the ferry of trying to "cheat the system".

He said that out of the 67 people rescued, only 35 had been listed on the passenger manifesto, leading to fears that there may have been dozens more people on board than the 133 on the official registry.

Edghill also said that the ferry's captain and at least one crew member had tested positive for cannabis.

"We have zero tolerance for members of the crew drinking or smoking while at work. And for us to have positive tests from the captain... this is serious," the minister said.

He added that the captain and several of his crew had been taken into police custody.

The ferry, MV Barima, departed from the capital, Georgetown, on Saturday afternoon local time, headed for Port Kaituma, in the north of the country.

The 40m-long (131ft) vessel was built in 1939, according to a listing on VesselFinder.

A survivor, Elena Moonsammy, told local news site Kiskadee Watch , external that the ferry had tilted after being hit by a large wave, with water quickly rushing in.

A distress call was received at 23:01 (03:01 GMT Sunday), triggering a search operation involving government teams and privately owned boats.

Moonsammy said she had survived by clinging to a box floating amidst the debris.

She had tried to hold on to the hand of her two-year-old child but they had been separated.

Moonsammy said she had managed to save a woman, whom she urged to also hold on to the floating box.

Among the 67 people rescued are 15 children. Small private boats were key in pulling at least 17 survivors from the sea.

Guyana's Health Minister, Dr Frank Anthony, said three of the survivors remained in hospital with minor injuries but the others had already been discharged.
body.zh: 当地时间周六晚上，一艘客轮在圭亚那海岸倾覆，预计有数十人溺水身亡。 官员称，周日有 67 人获救，但自那以后救援人员无法找到更多幸存者。 根据渡轮的乘客名单，船上载有 116 名乘客和 17 名船员，但圭亚那总理警告称，该名单并不准确。 潜水员继续搜寻船只倾覆的地点，并要求那些相信自己的亲人可能在失事船只上的人与当局联系。 总理马克·菲利普斯表示，已经对渡轮的损失展开调查。 他说：“让我绝对明确的是：一旦出现疏忽、不当行为或刑事不法行为，责任人将面临法律的全部制裁。” 圭亚那公共工程部长胡安·埃德吉尔在周日的新闻发布会上表达了他的愤怒，指责那些经营渡轮的人试图“欺骗系统”。 他表示，在获救的 67 人中，只有 35 人被列入乘客宣言，这导致人们担心机上人数可能比官方登记的 133 人多数十人。 埃德吉尔还表示，渡轮的船长和至少一名船员的大麻检测呈阳性。 “我们对船员在工作时饮酒或吸烟的态度是零容忍的。对于我们来说，船长的检测结果呈阳性……这很严重，”部长说。 他补充说，船长和几名船员已被警方拘留。 MV Barima渡轮于当地时间周六下午从首都乔治敦出发，前往该国北部的凯图马港。 根据 VesselFinder 上的列表，这艘 40m 长（131 英尺）的船只建于 1939 年。 幸存者埃琳娜·穆萨米 (Elena Moonsammy) 告诉当地新闻网站 Kiskadee Watch 外部，渡轮在受到大浪袭击后发生倾斜，水迅速涌入。 23:01（格林威治标准时间周日 03:01）收到求救信号，引发政府团队和私人船只参与的搜救行动。 穆萨米说，她靠着一个漂浮在废墟中的盒子才得以幸存。 她试图握住两岁孩子的手，但他们被分开了。 穆萨米说，她成功救了一名妇女，并敦促她也抓住漂浮的盒子。 获救的67人中有15名儿童。小型私人船只是从海上救出至少 17 名幸存者的关键。 圭亚那卫生部长弗兰克·安东尼博士表示，其中三名幸存者受轻伤仍在医院，但其他人已经出院。

title.en: Meet Andy Burnham, Britain's prime minister
title.zh: 认识安迪·伯纳姆，英国首相

summary.en: Andy Burnham has been sworn in as the new British Prime Minister, succeeding Keir Starmer. The former Manchester mayor is a prominent figure in the Labour Party and a popular politician in the UK.
summary.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆已宣誓就任英国新首相，接替基尔·斯塔默。这位前曼彻斯特市长是工党的重要人物，也是英国最受欢迎的政治家之一。

body.en:
Andy Burnham has been sworn in as the successor to British Prime Minister Keir Starmer. The former Manchester mayor has become a leading figure in the Labour Party and one of the UK's most popular politicians.

Nearly a month after the  resignation  of  Keir Starmer , former Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham , one of the  most popular politicians in Britain , has become the country's seventh prime minister in 10 years.

The move was made possible after Burnham won a by-election in the Makerfield constituency by a wide margin. He was then appointed as the leader of the ruling Labour Party on Friday, confirming him as Starmer's successor.

"Everyone can feel the country isn't where it should be," 56-year-old Burnham said after his Makerfield election victory, in remarks that already sounded distinctly prime ministerial. "From here on I will give everything I have got to make it so. To ensure the name Makerfield is forever synonymous with bringing about the change this country needs, bringing back something we've lost ― hope ― hope for the future."

Burnham is seen as a leading figure on Labour's moderate-left wing and has decades of experience in both national and regional politics. He first entered Parliament in 2001. Under Prime Minister Tony Blair , he served as a junior minister at the Home Office before Blair's successor, Gordon Brown, appointed him to roles at the Finance Ministry, the Department for Culture and later as health secretary.

Burnham even ran for the Labour leadership twice, in 2010 and 2015. In 2017, he left Parliament to become mayor of Greater Manchester, a region of around 2.8 million people in northern England. He has since won reelection twice, most recently getting nearly two-thirds of the vote.

Among Burnham's most notable achievements in Manchester is the expansion of affordable public transportation. Housing and health care have also been central priorities throughout his time as mayor. He has been critical of Brexit , the UK's exit from the European Union in 2020, and describes himself as an advocate of "pro-business socialism."

During the COVID pandemic, Burnham locked horns with then-Prime Minister Boris Johnson, demanding greater financial support for businesses and workers affected by lockdown restrictions. The confrontation and his general success in Manchester earned him the nickname "King of the North."

In the past few years, Burnham's main criticism of his Labour Party colleague Starmer has focused on the prime minister's cuts to welfare spending. Which policies Burnham will pursue as prime minister have so far largely remained undefined.

title.en: DRC's neighbors boost preparedness as Ebola cases surge
title.zh: 刚果民主共和国邻国加强应对埃博拉病例激增的准备

summary.en: Uganda, Rwanda and Zambia are strengthening border screening, disease surveillance and emergency response measures. The growing Ebola outbreak in the DRC is raising concerns about cross-border spread.

body.en:
Uganda, Rwanda and Zambia are strengthening border screening, disease surveillance and emergency response measures. The growing Ebola outbreak in the DRC is raising concerns about cross-border spread.

Countries bordering the Democratic Republic of Congo have stepped up screening at border crossings, trained frontl-ine health workers and activated emergency plans to reduce the risk of imported cases as the DRC battles a growing Ebola outbreak.

On Monday the DRC's Health Ministry reported that at least 930 people have died due to the illness. The DRC has recorded 2,344 cases of Bundibugyo, the virus behind the current outbreak, which the government declared on May 15. The  World Health Organization (WHO) recently warned that the number of cases could be up to four times higher than what is known .

In Zambia , authorities have stepped up screening at points of entry despite recording no confirmed Ebola cases. Dr. Naeem Dalal, assistant director for preparedness and response at the Zambia National Public Health Institute (ZNPHI), told DW that prevention measures had been reinforced nationwide.

"Infection prevention and control is currently being activated, where a lot of disinfection will be taking place, and face masks and washing of hands with soap and water will become mandatory," Dalal said.

He said provincial public health emergency response centers had been activated to coordinate a rapid response should suspected cases be detected.

Uganda , which has successfully contained previous Ebola outbreaks, has also increased surveillance along its border with the DRC. Speaking on Uganda National Television, Dr. Beda Senkware, of Kabale Referral Hospital, said three western districts of the country remained particularly vulnerable.

"The risk of getting this disease , Ebola, is very high. We have three districts that border the DRC — Kisoro, Kanungu and Rukungiri. These three districts have been put at the highest risk of getting Ebola," Senkware said.

Rwanda has likewise strengthened health screening at border crossings, expanded disease surveillance and prepared rapid response teams to investigate suspected cases.

Regional cooperation is also increasing. The East African Community (EAC) has agreed on a coordinated response to improve preparedness and reduce the risk of cross-border transmission.

EAC Secretary General Stephen Mbundi said partner states were working with the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC), the WHO and other partners to expand surveillance, laboratory testing and emergency response capacity.

title.en: Israel's embassy takes rare swipe at Labor's platform on eve of conference
title.zh: 以色列大使馆在会议前夕罕见地抨击了工党的政纲

summary.en: The four-page statement drew a shrug from a member of Labor's front bench.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Israel's embassy has rebuked the Labor party's draft national platform, warning its wording on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict places sole "responsibility" on the Jewish state while overlooking the role of Hamas and Palestinian leadership.

The four-page statement is a highly unusual intervention by a foreign government ahead of the party's national conference in Adelaide.

Labor's 2026 platform, which outlines the party's priorities and beliefs, contains an expanded statement on "Israel and Palestine" following the government's move to recognise Palestinian statehood, a longstanding part of the party platform.

The document reiterates support for a two-state solution, and also says the party "unreservedly condemns terrorism and violent extremism, including as perpetrated by Hamas and other extremists," stating Israelis and Palestinians deserve to live their lives free from terror and violence.

The platform says Israel "must comply with obligations as an occupying power" in supplying food and medical supplies for Palestinian civilians under international humanitarian law, and also condemns recent Knesset laws around the death penalty as "discriminatory."

The 'Death Penalty for Terrorists' law passed in March — and a subsequent 2026 military tribunal law — mandate capital punishment for Palestinians convicted of deadly attacks. The United Nations Human Rights Office warned the laws breach international humanitarian law and could amount to war crimes.

The unsigned Israeli embassy statement, released on Monday, reads: "The Embassy respectfully submits that several elements of the draft National Platform risk placing responsibility for the conflict on one party while giving insufficient attention to the decisions, conduct and continuing obligations of the Palestinian leadership and terrorist organisations such as Hamas."

"Israel has repeatedly demonstrated its willingness to make difficult compromises when genuine peace is possible."

While continuing to oppose Palestinian recognition, which the Australian government declared sovereign and independent in September 2025, Israel's embassy also disputed language in the draft platform condemning "extremist settler violence," which the government in June warned was at "horrific levels".

The embassy said settler violence "receives disproportionate attention," labelling it a "reprehensible but marginal phenomenon".

summary.en: Self-described misogynist Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan were arrested over the weekend in the US and face charges in multiple jurisdictions.

body.en:
On Sunday, social media influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate were arrested in Miami in the United States, after authorities in the United Kingdom issued 38 new charges against the brothers, deepening the pair's international legal saga and adding further complication to an already fraught legal situation.

The United Kingdom's Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) has charged the brothers — who deny all wrongdoing — with fresh counts of rape, actual bodily harm, and human trafficking.

The new accusations add to a mountain of serious charges against the pair and could lead to the brothers' extradition from the US, assuming it is approved by the US state department.

Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan Tate are dual US-UK citizens who have risen to prominence as social media influencers.

Andrew started his career in public life as a kickboxer and has gone on to become a prominent figure in the online 'manosphere' space, describing himself as a misogynist and encouraging his more than 10 million followers to follow in his footsteps.

He primarily posts on X, having been banned from YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram for violating hate speech guidelines.

Stephanie Wescott, a lecturer in humanities and social science at Monash University, described Andrew as the "main character" of this content, while his brother Tristan is more of a "side figure".

She said the Tates have turned disrespecting and abusing women into a business model that glamorises male dominance, 'teaching' men how to emulate them through an online academy.

"[They promote] anti-feminism, anti-gender-equality, and hyper-masculinity or, you know, 'men being men' or men going back to a type of manhood that no longer exists," she said.

"One of their business models has been to train other young men into becoming the sort of influencers that they claim that they are.

"Part of that business model has also been to exploit and harm the girls and women around you and to use their images as currency to sell online — we know Australian men have signed up for these services.

The pair have also expressed support for US President Donald Trump, and Trump's eldest son, Donald Trump Jr, spoke out against the brothers' detention in Romania in 2023.

"The other layer to this is, of course, that they have this incredible political proximity to Donald Trump," Wescott said.

In 2025, Andrew Tate said he was "very close with the Trump family". Trump himself has said little about the Tates, however.

"They have been supported and aided by adjacent figures, podcasters such as Joe Rogan and others like him," Wescott continued.

body.en:
There's a man with a bin on his head, three people representing the Monster Raving Loony Party, Nigel Farage and an Australian — now all vying for the seat vacated by the Reform UK leader in a crucial by-election.

The Clacton by-election, triggered by the parliamentary resignation of Farage over a donations scandal, has attracted all sorts of profiles to the mix.

Farage, who is under investigation over millions of pounds' worth of undeclared gifts and donations from wealthy backers, quit parliament earlier this month to trigger a by-election, but said he would re-contest his seat . The Reform UK leader said he wanted voters in his electoral district in south-east England to judge his actions, not what he said was a liberal "establishment" bent on discrediting him.

Farage is widely expected to win the seat again, and is the only mainstream candidate running, after other major parties said they would refuse to take part in what they characterised as a stunt.

A number of joke candidates — including Count Binface and another called 'Nick the Incredible Flying Brick' — are vying for the seat, along with 20 independents.

Pocock is a Swiss-Irish-Australian software engineer who describes himself as an "expert on cybersecurity, open source software [and] cryptocurrencies".

According to his website, he was born in the Melbourne suburb of Coburg before moving to rural Wandong. He graduated from the University of Melbourne in 2002 with a Bachelor of Computer Science.

While studying, he joined the National Union of Students and used his technical skills to assist websites for early social causes. He built a website opposing the death penalty after Schapelle Corby's arrest in Bali on drug trafficking charges.

He moved to Europe after graduation and worked for companies like Barclays Capital, Thomson Reuters, and UBS.

In a press release announcing his candidacy, Pocock says he was spurred to nominate himself for Clacton by the prospect of "novelty candidates".

"If the Essex Lion was to appear on the ballot paper, I suspect it would have an equally good chance of winning. I have yet to see a single report about the real, day-to-day issues facing residents of the district," he said.

"In a parody of this situation, I have chosen the codename Pocock-on-Sea for the operation to unleash an Australian upon London's Establishment."

title.en: 'Impossible': Nauru community detainees say Australian funds not enough to buy food with
title.zh: “不可能”：瑙鲁社区被拘留者称澳大利亚资金不足以购买食物

summary.en: They face a choice between paying for food, water or internet.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Asylum seekers being detained within the community in Nauru are struggling to buy enough food and are being forced to choose between eating and paying for other necessities.

The difficulties are being driven by a mix of high living costs and low income support, according to a new report by the Asylum Seeker Resource Centre.

Of 78 people interviewed for the report, 99 per cent said they couldn't afford to buy enough food with their current allowance.

On top of that, 68 per cent said they rarely or never had access to fresh fruit, vegetables and meat, and 82 per cent said they didn't have easy access to free, clean drinking water.

Community detainees live on $260 a fortnight to cover all of their basic needs outside accommodation.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The group have been sent to the tiny island nation under Australia's long-standing policy of offshore processing for asylum-seekers who arrive by boat.

Speaking anonymously, detainees consistently told the centre the allowance wasn't enough to sustain them, forcing them to decide between buying food and other necessities like clothing and internet access.

Many were running out of money before their next payment and were forced to reduce meals or go without food altogether.

"With food we have to compromise, if you buy vegetables you can't afford rice. If you buy meat, you can't afford fruit," one said.

"The money is not enough because everything is expensive here — rice, fish, we cannot buy any fruit here, internet for $100 per month, how is it possible to survive?" said another.

Nauru struggles with food insecurity due to its remote location and limited local agriculture, with perishable food flown in weekly and often selling out quickly or being prohibitively expensive.

With no rivers or freshwater lakes, the island also relies primarily on rainwater harvesting and desalination, meaning water shortages are common during times of low rainfall, forcing those who live there to turn to bottled water.

Asylum seekers in the community often struggle due to their lack of orientation or local knowledge as to how food systems work, as well as infrequent transportation to and from markets, the resource centre said.

As of 31 May, there were 101 people seeking asylum in Nauru, 91 of whom were in community accommodation.

The majority of those in detention in Nauru were young to middle-aged men from south and east Asia.

The group of asylum seekers are separate from a group of hundreds of former immigration detainees, known as the NZYQ cohort, sent to Nauru from Australia after the High Court in 2024 ruled indefinite detention to be unlawful.

title.en: Algeria seeks larger EU energy role amid regional tensions
title.zh: 阿尔及利亚在地区紧张局势中寻求更大的欧盟能源角色

summary.en: Algeria and Germany have agreed to strengthen their energy partnership following President Abdelmadjid Tebboune's visit to Berlin. This agreement comes as Algeria continues to face internal challenges, including tensions related to Western Sahara and broader instability across the Sahel region.
summary.zh: 阿尔及利亚总统阿卜杜勒马吉德·特布恩近期访问柏林后，阿尔及利亚与德国同意深化能源合作。然而，阿尔及利亚在国内仍面临紧张局势，包括西撒哈拉问题和萨赫勒地区的不稳定。

body.en:
Algeria and Germany agreed to deepen energy ties during President Abdelmadjid Tebboune's recent visit to Berlin. But Algiers is still grappling with tensions at home, over Western Sahara and instability in the Sahel.

For Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune, this week's visit to Berlin marked his first official trip to Germany since he was elected president in 2019. The two-day visit was highlighted in a joint statement with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, in which the two leaders emphasized "the quality of cooperation" between their countries and pledged to deepen long-term energy cooperation.

" Algeria is a central partner for Europe's energy security. Natural gas supplies and cooperation on renewable energies are to be expanded. In the long term, it is about establishing a southern hydrogen corridor — from North Africa to Germany," Cerstin Gammelin, the spokesperson for German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier posted on X on Thursday.

Algeria is home to Africa's second-largest proven natural gas reserves after Nigeria . It is also Africa's largest natural gas producer. On July 2, Algeria's state-owned energy company Sonatrach delivered the first shipment of liquefied natural gas (LNG) directly to Germany's Wilhelmshaven 1 floating LNG import terminal. A direct pipeline to Germany would eliminate the need for liquefaction, LNG shipping and regasification for those volumes. This could reduce transport costs for gas deliveries, as is already the case with Algeria's two existing pipelines to Italy  and Spain .

"The war in Iran and the disruption of oil exports via the Strait of Hormuz have reinforced Algeria's energy importance," said Alice Gower, director of geopolitics and security at the London-based consulting firm Azure Strategy.

"Although Algeria cannot replace Gulf supplies , its pipeline gas reaches southern Europe without passing through Gulf shipping lanes, offering European governments supply diversification at a time of renewed concern about energy security," she said.

This view is echoed by Hafed Al-Ghwell, director of the North Africa, Mediterranean and the Sahel program at the Washington-based think tank Stimson Center. Al-Ghwell told DW he recently met with Algeria's foreign minister and members of the cabinet.

"You can sense very clearly that there is the political will at the highest level of government that Algeria needs to take advantage of what is happening globally as well as its unique position as a major gas producer," he said.

Algeria's value for Europe extends well beyond gas, Gower pointed out. "Algiers offers cooperation on counterterrorism, migration and Mediterranean stability," she told DW.

body.zh: 阿尔及利亚和德国在总统阿卜杜勒马吉德·特本最近访问柏林期间同意深化能源关系。但阿尔及尔仍在努力应对国内紧张局势、西撒哈拉问题和萨赫勒地区的不稳定局势。 对于阿尔及利亚总统阿卜杜勒马吉德·特布恩来说，本周对柏林的访问是他自 2019 年当选总统以来首次对德国进行正式访问。与德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨的联合声明强调了为期两天的访问，两位领导人在声明中强调了两国之间的“合作质量”，并承诺深化长期能源合作。 “阿尔及利亚是欧洲能源安全的核心合作伙伴。天然气供应和可再生能源合作将得到扩大。从长远来看，这是关于建立一条南部氢走廊——从北非到德国，”德国总统弗兰克-瓦尔特·施泰因迈尔的发言人塞尔斯廷·加梅林周四在X上发帖称。 阿尔及利亚拥有非洲第二大天然气探明储量，仅次于尼日利亚。它也是非洲最大的天然气生产国。 7月2日，阿尔及利亚国有能源公司Sonatrach将第一批液化天然气（LNG）直接交付至德国威廉港1号浮式液化天然气进口码头。 直接通往德国的管道将消除这些体积的液化、液化天然气运输和再气化的需要。这可以降低天然气输送的运输成本，阿尔及利亚现有的两条通往意大利和西班牙的管道就是这种情况。 伦敦咨询公司Azure Strategy的地缘政治和安全总监爱丽丝·高尔(Alice Gower)表示：“伊朗战争和霍尔木兹海峡石油出口中断增强了阿尔及利亚的能源重要性。” 她说：“虽然阿尔及利亚无法取代海湾地区的供应，但其管道天然气无需经过海湾航道即可到达南欧，在人们重新担心能源安全之际，为欧洲各国政府提供了供应多元化。” 华盛顿智库史汀生中心北非、地中海和萨赫勒项目主任哈菲德·阿尔·格韦尔（Hafed Al-Ghwell）也赞同这一观点。 Al-Ghwell 告诉德国之声，他最近会见了阿尔及利亚外交部长和内阁成员。 他说：“你可以非常清楚地感觉到，阿尔及利亚政府最高层需要有政治意愿，以利用全球正在发生的事情及其作为主要天然气生产国的独特地位。” 高尔指出，阿尔及利亚对欧洲的价值远远超出了天然气的范围。她告诉德国之声：“阿尔及尔在反恐、移民和地中海稳定方面提供合作。” 多年来，阿尔及利亚一直与欧洲国家合作……

title.en: Food delivery rider wins China's top literary prize
title.zh: 外卖骑手荣获中国最高文学奖

summary.en: Wang Jibing, a food delivery rider, has been awarded China's most prestigious literary prize. His achievement highlights a growing trend of blue-collar workers in China gaining recognition for their literary contributions.
summary.zh: 外卖骑手王计兵荣获中国最高文学奖。他的成就凸显了中国蓝领工人因其文学作品而获得更广泛关注的趋势。

body.en:
A collection of poems, some scribbled on slips of paper between food deliveries, has won Wang Jibing one of China's top literary honours.

Low Flight, inspired by the everyday challenges delivery riders face, has bagged the Lu Xun Literary Prize - named after a writer who has been referred to as the father of modern Chinese literature.

Wang, 56, who became a delivery rider around 2019, gained traction on social media for his poems and essays.

He is part of a growing group of blue-collar workers who are being celebrated for their literary works, which offer a glimpse into the pressures that they face in China's massive gig economy.

For Wang, the prestigious literary prize comes after a few difficult decades as an odd job worker.

"I held my breath and felt extremely nervous… Once it was revealed, everything was settled," Wang told state media outlet Global Times on 15 July, when news broke that he had won the award - adding that the media attention around him had created a lot of mental pressure on him.

The monetary awards for recipients of the Lu Xun Literary Prize are not publicly announced - though as of 2014 it stood at 100,000 Chinese yuan ($14,800; £11,000).

Born in Jiangsu province, Wang left school as a teenager due to financial hardship at home. He took on various jobs, from construction to scavenging for waste and selling things at a street stall, before becoming a food deliveryman.

But his love for reading persisted, and over the last decade he has been posting his own poems and essays on social media.

In 2022, one of his poems, titled Man in a Hurry, went viral online. It was inspired by a incident in 2019, in which he spent hours on a frustrating delivery after a customer entered the wrong address.

In 2023 he published his first poetry collection, Man in a Hurry: Poems of a Food Delivery Rider.

Despite winning the award, Wang told the outlet he had no intention of quitting his job, adding that he planned to work until he turns 60.

"Financially I don't need this job to make a living, but I love the vibe of the work and it keeps me fit," said the Global Times report. "I want a down-to-earth life and the award will never change who I am."

Low Flight, published in 2024, is a collection of poems inspired by interviews and surveys that Wang conducted with around 200 delivery riders.

"Who says spreading your wings means flying high? Flying low is also flying," goes one of the lines in his poems.

His win comes as a growing number of blue worker collars in China have in recent years been making their mark in the literary world.

body.zh: 王吉兵的一本诗集（其中一些是在送餐期间写在纸条上的）为他赢得了中国最高文学荣誉之一。 《低空飞行》的灵感来自于外卖骑手每天面临的挑战，它获得了鲁迅文学奖——以一位被称为中国现代文学之父的作家的名字命名。 王现年 56 岁，2019 年左右成为一名送货骑手，他的诗歌和散文在社交媒体上受到关注。 他是越来越多的蓝领工人群体中的一员，这些工人因其文学作品而受到赞誉，这让人们得以一窥他们在中国庞大的零工经济中面临的压力。 对于王来说，享有盛誉的文学奖是在他作为打零工经历了几十年艰难的生活之后获得的。 7月15日，当他获奖的消息传出时，王告诉官方媒体《环球时报》：“我屏住呼吸，感到非常紧张……一旦揭晓，一切就都解决了。”他还补充说，周围媒体的关注给他带来了很大的精神压力。 鲁迅文学奖获奖者的奖金并未公开公布，但截至 2014 年，奖金为 10 万元人民币（14,800 美元；11,000 英镑）。 王出生于江苏省，青少年时期因家庭经济困难而辍学。在成为一名送餐员之前，他从事过各种工作，从建筑到清理垃圾，再到在街边摊上卖东西。 但他对阅读的热爱始终如一，在过去的十年里，他一直在社交媒体上发布自己的诗歌和散文。 2022年，他的一首诗《匆忙的男人》在网上疯传。它的灵感来自 2019 年的一次事件，当时一位顾客输入了错误的地址，他花了几个小时处理令人沮丧的送货事宜。 2023年，他出版了第一部诗集《匆忙的人：送餐骑手的诗》。 尽管获奖，王告诉媒体他无意辞职，并补充说他计划工作到 60 岁。 《环球时报》报道称：“从经济上来说，我不需要这份工作来谋生，但我喜欢这份工作的氛围，它让我保持健康。” “我想要脚踏实地的生活，这个奖项永远不会改变我是谁。” 《低空飞行》于 2024 年出版，是一本诗集，灵感来自于王对约 200 名送货骑手进行的采访和调查。 “谁说展翅高飞？低飞也是飞翔。”他的诗中有这样一句话。 他的获奖之际，近年来，越来越多的中国蓝领工人在文学界崭露头角。 前快递员胡安彦于 2023 年出版的回忆录《我在北京送包裹》在中国成为畅销书，也引起了海外媒体的关注。该回忆录的英文译本于去年出版......

body.en: Startling new research shows that in many countries – including old US allies – the public prefers Beijing to Washington Earlier this year, a spate of western TikTok and Instagram creators announced that they were at “a very Chinese time in my life” – drinking hot water and wearing slippers around their homes. The Chinamaxxing phenomenon primarily reflected the constant need of influencers for novel content. But social media trends also reflect a growing fascination with China, as the economic historian Adam Tooze has noted . While it broods over China’s economic, military and technical advance, the Trump administration is accelerating Beijing’s diplomatic progress, as striking new polling by the Pew Research Center shows. For the first time, China and Xi Jinping are seen more favourably than the US and its president in most of the 36 major countries surveyed – including Canada, Mexico and Australia. Only in six countries did people rate the US more highly. While Beijing has seen significant improvements in some places, the slump in Washington’s standing is more dramatic. Across 20 countries, the median percentage with a favourable view of China rose from 32% to 46% between 2023 and this year; for the US, it fell from 58% to 36%. Views of China were much more positive in Latin America, Africa and parts of south and south-east Asia than in wealthier European and east Asian countries. Continue reading...
body.zh: 令人震惊的新研究表明，在许多国家 — — 包括美国的老盟友 — — 公众更喜欢北京而不是华盛顿。 今年早些时候，一大批西方 TikTok 和 Instagram 创作者宣布，他们正处于“我一生中非常中国化的时期”——喝着热水，在家中穿着拖鞋。 Chinamaxshing现象主要反映了网红对新颖内容的持续需求。但正如经济历史学家亚当·图兹（Adam Tooze）指出的那样，社交媒体趋势也反映出人们对中国日益增长的迷恋。皮尤研究中心令人震惊的最新民意调查显示，在关注中国经济、军事和技术进步的同时，特朗普政府正在加速北京的外交进展。在接受调查的 36 个主要国家（包括加拿大、墨西哥和澳大利亚）中，大多数国家对中国和习近平的好感度首次高于美国及其总统。只有六个国家的人们对美国的评价更高。尽管北京在某些方面取得了显着进步，但华盛顿的地位下滑更为严重。 2023 年至今，20 个国家对中国持好感的中位数百分比从 32% 上升至 46%；美国则从 58% 下降至 36%。拉丁美洲、非洲以及南亚和东南亚部分地区对中国的看法比富裕的欧洲和东亚国家要积极得多。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The shifting global perceptions of superpowers, as highlighted in the news, remind us that a nation's true standing is often tied to its character and actions. Proverbs 14:34 suggests that righteousness elevates a people, while moral failings can bring disgrace. This perspective encourages us to consider how nations, like individuals, are ultimately judged...
reflection.zh: 新闻中强调的全球对超级大国看法的转变，提醒我们一个国家真正的地位往往与其品格和行为息息相关。箴言14:34指出，公义使邦国高举，罪恶是人民的羞辱。这一视角鼓励我们思考，国家如同个人，最终会因其正直和所体现的价值观而受到评判。

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verse.textZh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。

title.en: Trump is invoking foreign election interference to justify his own | Jamil Smith
title.zh: 特朗普援引外国选举干预来为自己辩护 | 贾米尔·史密斯

summary.en: An article discusses how the former president's claims of foreign election interference are used to justify his own actions, leading him to treat voters who opposed him as suspects rather than legitimate participants in the democratic process.
summary.zh: 一篇文章讨论了前总统如何援引外国选举干预来为自己的行为辩护，导致他将反对他的选民视为嫌疑犯，而非民主进程的合法参与者。

body.en: The president no longer treats the people who defeated him as voters. He treats them as suspects There is a version of this country in which Donald Trump tells Americans the truth he has been handed: that their elections are secure. Once, he apparently wanted to. The Atlantic reported after Thursday night’s address that a February 2020 election-security briefing pleased Trump so much he wanted to announce the news himself. The press conference never happened. The election did, and Trump lost it. Continue reading...
body.zh: 总统不再将击败他的人视为选民。他将他们视为嫌疑人。这个国家有一个版本，唐纳德·特朗普告诉美国人他所得到的真相：他们的选举是安全的。有一次，他显然想要这么做。 《大西洋月刊》在周四晚上的讲话后报道称，2020 年 2 月的选举安全简报令特朗普非常高兴，他想亲自宣布这一消息。新闻发布会从未发生过。选举确实发生了，但特朗普输了。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news highlights how a leader's refusal to accept election results and subsequent treatment of citizens as "suspects" can undermine trust and civic harmony. Proverbs 29:2 reminds us that the character of those in authority profoundly impacts the well-being of the people. When leaders govern with integrity and truth, society flourishes; when they do not,...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻揭示了领导人拒绝接受选举结果并将公民视为“嫌疑犯”的行为，如何损害信任和公民和谐。箴言29:2提醒我们，掌权者的品格深刻影响着民众的福祉。当领导人以正直和真理治理时，社会繁荣；反之，民众则会感到痛苦。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: China firm seeks damages over state control of British Steel
title.zh: 中国公司就英国钢铁国有化寻求赔偿

summary.en: China's Jingye Group is seeking compensation from the UK government after the government took over British Steel last year. The UK government intervened to prevent the closure of the country's last primary steelmaking facility, which Jingye Group had purchased in 2020.
summary.zh: 中国敬业集团正向英国政府寻求赔偿，此前英国政府去年接管了英国钢铁公司，以防止该国最后一个主要炼钢设施关闭。敬业集团于2020年收购了该公司。

body.en:
The UK government took over British Steel last year to prevent the closure of the country's last primary steelmaking facility. China's Jingye Group, which bought the firm in 2020, claims it is owed compensation.

A Chinese steel giant demanded compensation from the United Kingdom   government on Sunday, claiming the state's takeover of its subsidiary, British Steel, was "outright robbery."

The UK government took operational control of British Steel last year, after owner Jingye Group warned that Britain's last factory capable of making steel from scratch was no longer financially viable.

In a statement on social media, Jingye threatened legal action against the UK government, accusing ministers of "trampling on international investment rules."

Describing the nationalization as "outright robbery," the Chinese firm said it "reserves all legal rights, firmly defends its lawful rights and interests, and will pursue full compensation through legal means to the very end."

"The UK disregarded Jingye's continuous investment and significant contribution and was only willing to provide almost zero compensation,” the statement continued.

The company noted that nationalization could cost UK taxpayers more than 1.5 billion pounds ($2.02 billion, €1.76 billion) by 2028.

Jingye said it had begun a procedure under bilateral investment agreements to seek damages, without expanding further.

China's Foreign Ministry backed the compensation move, calling on the UK to "earnestly respect market principles and the spirit of contract, and find solutions on compensation and other issues acceptable to both sides."

After Jingye last year planned to close the blast furnaces at its plant in Scunthorpe, in northern England, the UK government passed emergency measures, allowing it to take  operational control of British Steel .

The immediate concern was that the blast furnaces would be shut permanently, ending the UK's capacity to produce virgin or primary steel from raw materials. The plant accounts for the vast majority of British Steel's operations.

The government cited national security for the move, which came five years after Jingye bought British Steel from a London-based private equity firm for around 70 million pounds.

Ministers cited the need to protect strategic steel supplies for construction, rail infrastructure and defense.

The move was also seen as a way to protect thousands of jobs in a deprived area of the UK. The Scunthorpe plant currently employs about 2,700 people.

In recent weeks, the UK Parliament has passed legislation that allowed the government on Thursday to bring British Steel into full public ownership.

body.zh: 英国政府去年接管了英国钢铁公司，以防止该国最后一个主要炼钢厂关闭。于 2020 年收购该公司的中国敬业集团声称其被欠赔偿。 周日，一家中国钢铁巨头要求英国政府赔偿，声称英国政府对其子公司英国钢铁公司的收购是“彻头彻尾的抢劫”。 去年，英国政府接管了英国钢铁公司的运营控制权，此前其所有者敬业集团警告称，英国最后一家能够从头开始生产钢铁的工厂不再具有财务可行性。 在周六社交媒体上的一份声明中，敬业威胁要对英国政府采取法律行动，指责部长们“践踏国际投资规则”。 这家中国公司将此次国有化描述为“彻头彻尾的抢劫”，并表示“保留一切合法权利，坚决捍卫合法权益，并将通过法律手段追究到底”。 声明还说：“英国无视敬业公司的持续投资和重大贡献，只愿意提供几乎为零的补偿。” 该公司指出，到 2028 年，国有化可能会让英国纳税人损失超过 15 亿英镑（20.2 亿美元，17.6 亿欧元）。 敬业表示，已根据双边投资协议启动了寻求损害赔偿的程序，但没有进一步扩大范围。 中国外交部支持这一赔偿举措，呼吁英方“切实尊重市场原则和契约精神，就赔偿等问题找到双方都能接受的解决方案”。 去年敬业计划关闭位于英格兰北部斯肯索普工厂的高炉后，英国政府通过了紧急措施，允许其对英国钢铁公司进行运营控制。 当务之急是高炉将永久关闭，从而结束英国利用原材料生产原生钢的能力。该工厂占英国钢铁公司业务的绝大多数。 政府以国家安全为由采取了这一举措，五年前敬业以约 7000 万英镑从一家伦敦私募股权公司手中收购了英国钢铁公司 (British Steel)。 部长们指出有必要保护建筑、铁路基础设施和国防的战略钢铁供应。 此举也被视为保护英国贫困地区数千个就业岗位的一种方式。 斯肯索普工厂目前拥有约 2,700 名员工。 最近几周，英国议会通过了一项立法，允许政府于周四将英国钢铁公司完全纳入公有制。 根据新法律，独立评估师必须评估是否有...

reflection.en: When governments intervene in economic affairs, the call for justice and righteousness remains paramount. Yahweh's word reminds leaders to act fairly, ensuring that all parties, including investors, are treated equitably and not unjustly deprived. This principle encourages thoughtful consideration of compensation and fair dealings in complex situations...
reflection.zh: 当政府干预经济事务时，对公义和正直的呼吁至关重要。雅伟的话语提醒领导者要公正行事，确保包括投资者在内的所有各方都受到公平对待，不被不公正地剥夺。这一原则鼓励在涉及国家利益和私营企业的复杂情况下，深思熟虑赔偿和公平交易。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Trump, not Iran, is the world’s greatest danger. He’s a one-man weapon of mass destruction | Simon Tisdall
title.zh: 特朗普，而非伊朗，是世界上最大的危险。他是一个人的大规模杀伤性武器 | 西蒙·蒂斯代尔

summary.en: The article argues that the US president's actions have initiated a disastrous war and an economic quagmire, leading to a "limitless fiasco" as bombing resumes. It characterizes the president as "feckless and clueless," unable to navigate or exit the conflict he started.
summary.zh: 文章指出，随着轰炸再次开始，美国总统的行为已将美国拖入一场无止境的灾难和经济泥潭。文章形容这位总统“无能又糊涂”，无法摆脱他所发动的这场灾难性战争。

body.en: As the bombing starts again, it’s clear the president has dragged the US into a limitless fiasco – and the world into an economic quagmire Feckless and clueless, Donald Trump is lost in Iran, unable to find a way out of the disastrous war he started. Once again, the US military is pummelling the country and, increasingly, its civilian infrastructure. As before, this unlawful bludgeoning strengthens the resistance of a hardline regime that cares little for its people’s suffering. How often have Trump and Pete Hegseth, the Pentagon’s wildling lord of bones, hailed a bogus victory? The president claimed this week to be “winning big”. No one believes him. Even as it counts the vast human and economic cost of his Persian folly, a watching world scoffs at US impotence. Control of the strait of Hormuz, closed due to Trump’s belligerence, is now the White House’s limited, elusive objective. The grander US and Israeli war aims – eliminating Iran’s nuclear programme, degrading its regional militias, regime change – are less attainable than ever. It’s Trump’s craven leadership that renders US forces ineffective, not the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. If Iran really is the existential menace he claims, the logical course would be all-out conquest. When George W Bush decided Iraq posed unacceptable dangers, he invaded with 170,000 ground troops. It was a catastrophe. But at least Bush had balls. Simon Tisdall is a Guardian foreign affairs commentator Continue reading...
body.zh: 随着轰炸再次开始，很明显，总统已将美国拖入了无限的惨败 — — 并将世界拖入了经济泥潭。 无能又无能的唐纳德·特朗普在伊朗迷失了方向，无法找到摆脱他发起的灾难性战争的出路。美国军队再次对该国进行打击，并越来越多地打击其民用基础设施。和以前一样，这种非法的殴打加强了一个不关心人民苦难的强硬政权的抵抗。特朗普和五角大楼的野人骸骨领主皮特·赫格斯多少次欢呼一场虚假的胜利？总统本周声称“大获全胜”。没有人相信他。尽管他的波斯愚蠢行为造成了巨大的人力和经济成本，但全世界都在嘲笑美国的无能。控制因特朗普的好战而关闭的霍尔木兹海峡，现在已成为白宫有限且难以捉摸的目标。美国和以色列更宏伟的战争目标——消除伊朗核计划、削弱其地区民兵、政权更迭——比以往任何时候都更难以实现。导致美军效率低下的是特朗普胆怯的领导，而不是伊斯兰革命卫队。如果伊朗确实是他所声称的生存威胁，那么合乎逻辑的路线将是全面征服。当乔治·W·布什认定伊拉克构成了无法接受的危险时，他派遣了 17 万地面部队入侵。这是一场灾难。但至少布什有胆量。西蒙·蒂斯达尔是卫报外交事务评论员继续阅读...

reflection.en: This proverb reminds us of the profound and often devastating impact that leaders can have on their people and the world. When those in power act recklessly or without wisdom, the consequences can be like a destructive force, leaving nations in turmoil and people vulnerable. It underscores the heavy responsibility of leadership and the need for discernment...
reflection.zh: 这句箴言提醒我们，领袖对他们的人民和世界可能产生深刻而往往是毁灭性的影响。当掌权者鲁莽行事或缺乏智慧时，其后果可能像一股破坏性的力量，使国家陷入混乱，人民变得脆弱。它强调了领导的重任以及对执政者保持明辨的重要性。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

This despite assessments from intelligence officials that no foreign actor, including China, attempted to alter any technical aspect of the 2020 voting process. Continue reading...

Proverbs 29:2 reminds us that the character of leadership profoundly impacts the well-being of a nation, bringing either joy or groaning to its people. May we seek leaders whose actions foster unity and trust, reflecting...
reflection.zh: 当领导人提出未经证实的指控并威胁民主进程的完整性时，这可能在民众中播下分裂和焦虑的种子。箴言29:2提醒我们，领导人的品格深刻影响着一个国家的福祉，给人民带来喜乐或叹息。愿我们寻求那些其行动能促进团结和信任、并致力于共同利益的领导人。

verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: Fact-checking Donald Trump’s address on Chinese election interference – video
title.zh: 事实核查唐纳德·特朗普关于中国干预选举的讲话——视频

The US president revived long-running attacks on election security, despite a US intelligence assessment that found no evidence Beijing altered the 2020 vote, which he lost. The Guardian's voting rights reporter Sam Levine factchecks some of Trump's claims Trump is invoking foreign election interference to justify his own - Opinion Continue reading...

reflection.en: In public discourse, initial claims can often sound convincing until they are thoroughly examined. This story reminds us of the importance of careful scrutiny and hearing all sides, especially when serious allegations are made. Yahweh encourages us to seek wisdom and not to accept every statement at face value.
reflection.zh: 在公共讨论中，最初的说法往往听起来很有说服力，直到它们被彻底审查。这个故事提醒我们，仔细审查和听取各方意见的重要性，尤其是在提出严重指控时。雅伟鼓励我们寻求智慧，不要轻信每一个说法。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Beijing’s message to the world’s tourists: come here and judge China for yourselves | Zichen Wang
title.zh: 北京向世界游客发出信息：来中国，亲自评判

summary.en: Beijing has relaxed its visa rules, aiming to boost its economy and enhance its international image. The move has led to a noticeable return of foreign tourists to the capital, engaging in sightseeing and local activities.
summary.zh: 北京放宽了签证规定，旨在提振经济并改善其国际形象。此举已使外国游客明显回流首都，他们正在观光并参与当地活动。

body.en: By relaxing visa rules, Beijing has two things on its mind – boosting its economy and improving its self-image Walk through central Beijing today and one thing quickly becomes apparent: foreigners are back. They are taking photos outside the Forbidden City and sitting in cafes around Gulou and Sanlitun. The shift is visible online, too; YouTube is increasingly filled with videos titled “China Shocked Me” or “My First Week in China”. Most of the creators are tourists, not China specialists or journalists, and many of them are encountering the country for the first time. The resurgence is striking because to many outside observers China’s story has become one of closure and increased security – of intensifying strategic rivalry with the west, expanded anti-espionage enforcement and increasingly constrained foreign reporting, including the withholding and revocation of visas for US journalists. Yet on the ground, another story is unfolding. When it comes to its relationship with the rest of the world, Beijing increasingly appears to be betting on direct exposure: come to China and judge for yourself. Zichen Wang is deputy secretary-general at the Center for China and Globalization, a thinktank in Beijing. body.en:
In a speech attacking US election integrity on Friday, US President Donald Trump released intelligence that he said showed major Chinese interference in US elections, reviving his false claims he won the 2020 election.

Trump's allegations about the "shocking vulnerabilities" in the American electoral system appeared to lay the groundwork for the Republican to dispute the results of November's crucial US midterm elections .

It underscored Trump's effort to make election security a central political issue ahead of November's midterm vote, when Republicans in Congress will face the prospect of losing control of both the House of Representatives and Senate — an outcome that would carry significant political consequences for Trump.

"We can never watch a stolen election again," Trump said in the primetime address, referencing his 2020 presidential election defeat by Democrat Joe Biden.

Trump said he was declassifying huge amounts of intelligence data that showed, among other things, that superpower rival China had illicitly acquired 220 million US voter files.

"Over a period of years, starting during the 2020 election cycle, the People's Republic of China carried out what is believed to be the largest compromise of election data in history," Trump said in the televised speech from the White House.

He asserted that members of the US intelligence community deliberately suppressed information about the extent of China's activities.

His allegations contradict an unclassified 2021 US intelligence community assessment that found no indications any foreign actor tried to alter or succeeded in altering "any technical aspect" of the 2020 presidential election vote.

The assessment was conducted under John Ratcliffe, then Trump's director of national intelligence and now his CIA director.

Trump also claimed there were more than 250,000 non-US citizens registered to vote in four states.

Trump has persistently claimed his 2020 election defeat was "rigged," although more than 60 lawsuits produced no ruling establishing fraud capable of changing the outcome, while recounts, audits and his own justice department found none.

After railing against election security in the 25-minute address, Trump pressed Republicans in Congress to pass his signature elections legislation, the SAVE America Act, which has been stalled for months.

It seeks to impose new voter identification and citizenship requirements, despite longstanding findings that voter fraud in US elections is rare.

Election security experts have said these measures would make it harder for millions of eligible voters to cast a ballot.

body.en:
Israel's embassy has rebuked the Labor party's draft national platform, warning its wording on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict places sole "responsibility" on the Jewish state while overlooking the role of Hamas and Palestinian leadership.

The four-page statement is a highly unusual intervention by a foreign government ahead of the party's national conference in Adelaide.

Labor's 2026 platform, which outlines the party's priorities and beliefs, contains an expanded statement on "Israel and Palestine" following the government's move to recognise Palestinian statehood, a longstanding part of the party platform.

The document reiterates support for a two-state solution, and also says the party "unreservedly condemns terrorism and violent extremism, including as perpetrated by Hamas and other extremists," stating Israelis and Palestinians deserve to live their lives free from terror and violence.

The platform says Israel "must comply with obligations as an occupying power" in supplying food and medical supplies for Palestinian civilians under international humanitarian law, and also condemns recent Knesset laws around the death penalty as "discriminatory."

The 'Death Penalty for Terrorists' law passed in March — and a subsequent 2026 military tribunal law — mandate capital punishment for Palestinians convicted of deadly attacks. The United Nations Human Rights Office warned the laws breach international humanitarian law and could amount to war crimes.

The unsigned Israeli embassy statement, released on Monday, reads: "The Embassy respectfully submits that several elements of the draft National Platform risk placing responsibility for the conflict on one party while giving insufficient attention to the decisions, conduct and continuing obligations of the Palestinian leadership and terrorist organisations such as Hamas."

"Israel has repeatedly demonstrated its willingness to make difficult compromises when genuine peace is possible."

While continuing to oppose Palestinian recognition, which the Australian government declared sovereign and independent in September 2025, Israel's embassy also disputed language in the draft platform condemning "extremist settler violence," which the government in June warned was at "horrific levels".

The embassy said settler violence "receives disproportionate attention," labelling it a "reprehensible but marginal phenomenon".

UN monitors have documented over 1,000 Israeli settler attacks causing casualties or property damage this year, averaging six incidents per day and resulting in the displacement of more than 2,200 Palestinians.

title.en: The Tate brothers' international legal saga: The cases, charges and what comes next
title.zh: 泰特兄弟的国际法律纠葛：案件、指控及后续发展

summary.en: Self-described misogynist Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan were arrested over the weekend in the US and face charges in multiple jurisdictions.
summary.zh: 自称厌女主义者的安德鲁·泰特及其兄弟特里斯坦周末在美国被捕，并面临多项司法管辖区的指控。

body.en:
On Sunday, social media influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate were arrested in Miami in the United States, after authorities in the United Kingdom issued 38 new charges against the brothers, deepening the pair's international legal saga and adding further complication to an already fraught legal situation.

The United Kingdom's Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) has charged the brothers — who deny all wrongdoing — with fresh counts of rape, actual bodily harm, and human trafficking.

The new accusations add to a mountain of serious charges against the pair and could lead to the brothers' extradition from the US, assuming it is approved by the US state department.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan Tate are dual US-UK citizens who have risen to prominence as social media influencers.

Andrew started his career in public life as a kickboxer and has gone on to become a prominent figure in the online 'manosphere' space, describing himself as a misogynist and encouraging his more than 10 million followers to follow in his footsteps.

He primarily posts on X, having been banned from YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram for violating hate speech guidelines.

Stephanie Wescott, a lecturer in humanities and social science at Monash University, described Andrew as the "main character" of this content, while his brother Tristan is more of a "side figure".

She said the Tates have turned disrespecting and abusing women into a business model that glamorises male dominance, 'teaching' men how to emulate them through an online academy.

"[They promote] anti-feminism, anti-gender-equality, and hyper-masculinity or, you know, 'men being men' or men going back to a type of manhood that no longer exists," she said.

"One of their business models has been to train other young men into becoming the sort of influencers that they claim that they are.

"Part of that business model has also been to exploit and harm the girls and women around you and to use their images as currency to sell online — we know Australian men have signed up for these services.

The pair have also expressed support for US President Donald Trump, and Trump's eldest son, Donald Trump Jr, spoke out against the brothers' detention in Romania in 2023.

"The other layer to this is, of course, that they have this incredible political proximity to Donald Trump," Wescott said.

In 2025, Andrew Tate said he was "very close with the Trump family". Trump himself has said little about the Tates, however.

"They have been supported and aided by adjacent figures, podcasters such as Joe Rogan and others like him," Wescott continued.

title.en: Nigel Farage's unusual UK by-election now has an Australian candidate
title.zh: 奈杰尔·法拉奇不寻常的英国补选现有一名澳大利亚候选人

summary.en: Nigel Farage will compete in the Clacton by-election against several candidates, including Count Binface and Australian Daniel Pocock.
summary.zh: 奈杰尔·法拉奇将在克拉克顿补选中与包括宾费斯伯爵和澳大利亚人丹尼尔·波科克在内的多位候选人竞争。

body.en:
There's a man with a bin on his head, three people representing the Monster Raving Loony Party, Nigel Farage and an Australian — now all vying for the seat vacated by the Reform UK leader in a crucial by-election.

The Clacton by-election, triggered by the parliamentary resignation of Farage over a donations scandal, has attracted all sorts of profiles to the mix.

Farage, who is under investigation over millions of pounds' worth of undeclared gifts and donations from wealthy backers, quit parliament earlier this month to trigger a by-election, but said he would re-contest his seat . The Reform UK leader said he wanted voters in his electoral district in south-east England to judge his actions, not what he said was a liberal "establishment" bent on discrediting him.

Farage is widely expected to win the seat again, and is the only mainstream candidate running, after other major parties said they would refuse to take part in what they characterised as a stunt.
